I checked every `.copyTo(` call in `guava-tests/` (excluding `android/`) and identified which pass a `ByteSink` (vs. `OutputStream`), and filtered out all `CharSource.copyTo` calls.

Methods that call `ByteSource.copyTo(ByteSink)`:

1. `ByteSourceTester.testCopyTo_byteSink` — `guava-tests/test/com/google/common/io/ByteSourceTester.java:157-168` (constructs an anonymous `ByteSink`)
2. `ByteSourceTest.testCopyTo_byteSink` — `guava-tests/test/com/google/common/io/ByteSourceTest.java:117-127`
3. `ByteSourceTest.testClosesOnErrors_copyingToByteSinkThatThrows` — `ByteSourceTest.java:319-329`
4. `ByteSourceTest.testClosesOnErrors_whenReadThrows` — `ByteSourceTest.java:331-335`
5. `ByteSourceTest.runSuppressionFailureTest` — `ByteSourceTest.java:420-423` (test helper: `in.copyTo(out)` where `out` is typed `ByteSink`)
6. `ByteSinkTest.testClosesOnErrors_copyingFromByteSourceThatThrows` — `guava-tests/test/com/google/common/io/ByteSinkTest.java:84-95`
7. `ByteSinkTest.testClosesOnErrors_whenWriteThrows` — `ByteSinkTest.java:97-101`

Excluded: `ByteSourceTester.testCopyTo_outputStream`, `ByteSourceTest.testCopyTo_outputStream`, `ByteSourceTest.testCopyToStream_doesNotCloseThatStream`, `ByteSourceTest.testClosesOnErrors_copyingToOutputStreamThatThrows` (all use `OutputStream`), and all calls in `CharSourceTest`, `CharSourceTester`, `CharSinkTest` (these are `CharSource.copyTo`).

ANSWER: ByteSourceTester.testCopyTo_byteSink, ByteSourceTest.testCopyTo_byteSink, ByteSourceTest.testClosesOnErrors_copyingToByteSinkThatThrows, ByteSourceTest.testClosesOnErrors_whenReadThrows, ByteSourceTest.runSuppressionFailureTest, ByteSinkTest.testClosesOnErrors_copyingFromByteSourceThatThrows, ByteSinkTest.testClosesOnErrors_whenWriteThrows
